content.text: Wealth in Bazi Is About Structure, Not Just Effort
In classical Bazi theory, wealth is represented by specific stars and element interactions. When the structure supports wealth, financial opportunities flow more naturally.
The Role of the Day Master
A strong and supported Day Master can manage wealth energy effectively. If too weak or overwhelmed, financial gains may be unstable.
Balanced elements allow wealth stars to activate without creating stress or imbalance. Excess or deficiency can block smooth financial growth.
Even a well-structured chart needs favorable timing. Luck pillars can significantly enhance or reduce wealth attraction periods.
